notes.title: Majestic patch
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

In my desire to make the best game possible, I have invested time in the development of the Majestic patch, which includes substantial changes such as the following:
[list]
[*]Fullscreen or windowed mode with your choice of resolution (it is still recommended to play at 1920 x 1080). This new option will come in handy for people who play on wall-sized screens.
[*]Inclusion of hints in the form of text or animated objects to make the puzzles easier to understand (especially the menu making, Rex's room and the tailor's shop).
[*]Several of Lex's animations have been improved and some scenarios have been detailed so that interactions can be better found.
[*]Some lines of dialogue and text have been merged into one.
[*]The option to load chapters has been removed. Play in old school mode.
[*]Some sounds have been changed to better quality, especially the footsteps.
[*]Some other things I'm missing (it's been a hard task).
[/list]

You may see small updates from time to time, but this will probably be the last patch the game gets.

Lex loves you, keep playing.

notes.title: Press Lex to Metaverx - Second anniversary
notes.notes:
Lovely people,

On the occasion of the second anniversary of [b]Press Lex to Metaverx[/b], the new patch includes:
[list]
[*]Fixed some bugs regarding some images after loading.
[*]Better pace in some parts of the game.
[*]Added chapter titles for both main parts of the game: [b]Random Access Memories[/b] and [b]Incidents in an expanding universe[/b]. (Pop culture references in your face!).
[/list]

If you have played it, recommend it, if you haven´t... Grab that huge sale!
Lex loves you all!

notes.title: Third anniversary!
notes.notes:
Lovely Majesties,

[b]From Lex to Rex [/b]is about to be three years old! The baby has grown and is awaiting a second brother this year. As the anniversary coincides with the Spring Sale, let´s celebrate it with a HUGE disscount for those of you who haven´t tasted this delicatesen yet.

The patch includes a change in the speech text: no more typewriter scroll.

Thanks! Keep playing!

notes.title: No Rest for Lex - Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

This Monday I'm presenting the conclusion of the Lex saga, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454180/No_Rest_for_Lex/][b]No Rest for Lex[/b][/url], at the Steam Next Fest. For the duration of the festival I will be streaming demo and answering related questions.
Also, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794030/From_Lex_to_Rex/][b]From Lex to Rex[/b][/url] will soon be celebrating its third anniversary.

Keep playing!

notes.title: No Rest for Lex - Demo
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

You can now enjoy the [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3476590/No_Rest_for_Lex_Demo/]No Rest for Lex[/url][/i] demo, which will be availble for a week. 
Hope you enjoy it and I expect your feedback.

notes.title: No Rest for Lex
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

I am pleased to announce the new adventure of your beloved character. [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454180/No_Rest_for_Lex/]No Rest for Lex[/url][/b].
[list]
[*]This will be the last adventure of the character. It will follow the line and stories of the previous ones. You can expect everything you saw in them and more, with simplified mechanics and mini-games.
[*]There will be a demo available soon that will cover the start of the adventure.
[*]The estimated release date is August if everything goes as it is going so far.
[*]Apart from the next edition of Steam Next Fest, I hope to be featured in more narrative festivals and promotion channels. If anyone knows of any please let me know. Any help is welcome.
[/list]
Little more to add. I hope you join me in this last adventure that will not leave anyone indifferent.

Lex loves you.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454180/No_Rest_for_Lex/]No Rest for Lex[/url][/b]

notes.title: Small fix - Happy New Year
notes.notes:
Hi, Majesties,

This patch includes a fix regarding the puzzle involving the wolf head and the metal plate. If you tried to place it from the inside then a weird bug happened that wouldn´t allow the player to place it from the outside.

I would like to take this opportunity to wish you a Happy New Year full of games, laughs and probably a new Lex game. Enjoy. Lex loves you.

notes.title: Long live the Rex!
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

Once again this year you can vote for [b]From Lex to Rex[/b]. This year all the reviews have been positive and it was well received at the Steam Cooking Fest.
You know I'm always there to solve any doubts or problems.
Thank you. Keep playing. Review, it helps the most.

[b]Lex loves you.[/b]

notes.title: New Game: Stuff to do - Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Lovely people,

I am proud to announce my new game: [b]Stuff to do[/b]. A minimalist and experimental escape-room with touches of psychological horror. A total drift from my previous games, however you will still find intriguing puzzles and mystery as well as some [b]interesting gameplay mechanics[/b].

The demo will be available during the Steam Next Fest in the link bellow:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3200110/Stuff_to_do/]Stuff to do[/url]

Use your head, your hands. And remember to check your pulse.

notes.title: Ultrawide Lex
notes.notes:
Your lovely Majesties,

Now you can enjoy the game in Ultrawide monitors. Long live Lex!

More news coming soon.

notes.title: The Metaverx turns one!
notes.notes:
Your Majesties, may the 4th... [b]First anniversary![/b]

I have to say that I love this game. The goal was clear from the beginning: to apply everything I learnt in the first one and translate it here. It has been accomplished.

On the other hand, despite having participated in a Steam Next Fest, having a better promotion (From Lex to Rex didn't have any), the wishlist and the congratulation messages, the game hasn't had the expected buzz, although, ironically, it has made more players go to the first one.

In the end Lex has ended up being an extension of myself (if he wasn't already in the first one): someone who has to do everything and persists despite the odds with humour, pretty much my summary as an indie developer.

[b]Both games will be on sale during these days[/b]. Take the opportunity to grab them or recommend them if you consider it (and leaving a review too, this helps a lot).

Keep playing. Lex loves you.

notes.title: French
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

From Lex to Rex is now available in French! I will probably add some more languages (sugestions?), however it takes a ton of time so be patient. The next goal is to finish the french translation of Press Lex to Metaverx.

This patch also includes some minor fixings like a typo here and there and a trim in the code so the game can work even better.

Enjoy.

notes.title: Two years, two games and...
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

[b]From Lex to Rex is about to be two years old in no time.[/b] It has been as crazy as Lex´s adventures. 

I can say I am quite proud with the game, especially after the polishing and improving. In the end, as I said before, this has been a learning experience. Thanks to you the game is still working and didn´t get lost down there in Steam´s deepness.
Thanks from the bottom of my heart. 

Now, once again I ask you (because asking is free and sometimes works) to consider [b]leaving a review[/b] for the game (or, while you´re at it, for both of them). This one is undoubtely the hardest quest of them all, even though I receive congratulations messages. This way you will help me shake Steam´s algorithm to make the game more visible. It really helps. It is so hard to get a review that something related will be included in the next game...

Because, yes, Lex still has one adventure left.

Keep playing.

notes.title: Nomination and charity!
notes.notes:
Majesties,

I hope this Royal message finds you full of energy. For the second time the game has been nominated to te Steam Awards, this time, as you can see, in the [b]Labor of love[/b] category. Holy starters, how can that be possible? Well, this year the game received a major update (Royal patch) that included: 
[list][*]Polished animations.
[*]A complete change of sound effects and the addition of profesional music.
[*]An autosave system.
[*]A new secret zone with four exclusive achievements.
[/list]And as you know I´m always checking if there are possible doubts, through the forum or privately. That is why I ask you to consider voting them in this category (or at least leave a review).

In addition to this, just like last year, some of the money made of this month´s sales is going directly to the food collection campaing that will take place this week.

Lex loves you. Enjoy and keep playing.

notes.title: 1 1/2 Patch
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

The pace of the cinematics has been improved, this means there´s more time to appreciate the actions and the dialogues (there were some scenes that felt a little rushed). A small blink in an animation has been fixed. Some dialogue lines have been gathered in one complete sentence.

Keep playing and, once again, [b]be kind and review[/b].

notes.title: Summer sale! Reviews! Madness!
notes.notes:
Majesties,

Summer sale starts tomorrow, the best momento for you to get any of the games, even both of them with an additional discount. Madness!

I also encourage you to leave a [b]review[/b]. It´s [b]a small gesture that means a lot to us, indie developers[/b]. 

Thank you. Enjoy. Rock´n´roll.

notes.title: Greetings and minor patch.
notes.notes:
Majesties,
First of all, greetings to the (many) new players who have decide to join Lex in his quest. As you may have already seen (or will see soon) he will need your help, so he´s certainly grateful.

[list]
[*]This patch includes minor fixes that didn´t affect the playability: some pacing between actions (some felt a little rushed); the music from the first stage kept playing for a while during the second one, that´s now fixed; a sudden camera blink and the main character position after using an inventory object on an NPC (he moved to one place and then headed to the right one). Fixed.
[*]If you see minor patches from now on that means I´m polishing little things like the pacing.
[*]If you enjoyed this adventure, please check the awesome new one [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2091740/Press_Lex_to_Metaverx/]Press Lex to Metaverx[/url]
[*]There are some interesting news coming.
[*]Should you like to share your love, leaving a review could be the ultimate gesture!
[/list]

Thanks a lot. Keep playing!

notes.title: Launch day.
notes.notes:
Majesties, Press Lex to Metaverx arrives today.

I´m so proud of it and everything I´ve learnt. It is a bigger step from the first one in all aspects with an awesome story linked to the gameplay. I´ve spent hours and hours of dedication (I truly don´t want to know how many to avoid a heart attack), sometimes almost going crazy, but here is the result. Being a one-man project it is easy that I´ve missed some typos or bugs, so please, majesties, just let me know and I´ll fix them before you can say blueberry pie.

I hope you play it, enjoy it and support me. Thank you so very much.

notes.title: The Metaverx is coming.
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2091740/Press_Lex_to_Metaverx/]Press Lex to Metaverx[/url] arrives on the [b]fourth of may.[/b]

A moving story awaits you. See you soon.

notes.title: From Lex to Rex - First anniversary
notes.notes:
Today is [b]From Lex to Rex[/b]´s first anniversary.

It started as a feat (it really was) turned into reality. I have probably said this before, but in the end it has been a learning experience. I can assure you I´ve spent many nights thinking about how solving unexpected bugs or investing more hours than any other person would just to improve the game. There were oppossed emotions, highs and lows and even once I dreamt about a character that didn´t allow me to keep developing the game (can you guess which one?).

Now all this is part of the experience of developing an indie game.

A year later I´m finishing the (unexpected) sequel [b]Press Lex to Metaverx[/b] of which I attach a new image. There will news soon. Meanwhile, keep playing, unlock those achievements, spread the word about the game and if you want to do extra mile leave a review. Every little gesture helps.

Thanks for being there.


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2091740/Press_Lex_to_Metaverx/]Press Lex to Metaverx[/url]

notes.title: Secret area and four new achievements.
notes.notes:
Your Majesties,

Somewhere in the castle, hidden and awating to be found, there´s a secret area where Creepshow and Boris Vian meet to deliver a crazy puzle that will take you around twenty minutes to beat (all achievements included). However, it won´t be easy to find. Look around, examine and think.

Thanks for playing, keep doing it, enjoy and be kind, review.

notes.title: Royal path
notes.notes:
Your majesties,

In order to make the best game possible, this Royal patch is a huge one.
[list]
[*]Fixed the repetition of the first frame at the end of some (or many) animations. 
[*]Autosave system / Resume button on the main menu.
[*]New music and sounds: 90% of the sounds have been changed for better ones. There are more ambient and objects sounds and new music (even where there wasn´t any). I must say the lack of music was made on purpose (think of the first Monkey Island) but now I´ve made a more "inmersive" game.
[*] The second part of the rooftop stage has been completely reworked (thanks for the crash Unity and AC). The puzzles remain the same but the dialogues have been changed for funnier ones (overall the main message is the same). New animations have been added.
[*] In case of death (of the character, of course) the scene starts on a previous point and not at the beginning. Keep in mind that this case is in some stages, however the next update will have it in all of the ones you can die).
[*]Many more things for you to enjoy. The game keeps its difficulty.
[/list]

And if you´ve made it this far, the next update will bring more inventory interactions (examine, trying combinations...) and, possibly...

A secret stage.

Thanks a lot!

notes.title: Thank you.
notes.notes:
Your Majesties, 

I would like to wish all those who have played From Lex to Rex a happy New Year. 2022 has been an important one, highlighted by the release of my first game, something that, not so far ago, wasn´t even in my list of intentions. It has probably been the most difficult creative task I´ve ever done and it has provided me with tons of knowledge and insight about this world I enjoy so much: the videogames one.

Thanks for giving it a chance. Now it´s turn to keep focused on the next project, something bigger in all aspects.

Happy New Year.

notes.title: Minor update - Food bank - Steam Awards
notes.notes:
Your majesties, 
[list]
[*]The new patch includes better sounds and music (main hall and feast stages). 
[*] Changed some dialogue lines (for better ones).
[*] [b]That "hidden" object almost everybody complains about at the tailor´s has now a short animation to make it more visible.[/b] Don´t expect neon lights, but is there.  
[/list]

Charity: as promised I made a donation to the food bank with most of the money earnt from these two last sales.

Steam Awards: you can nominate From Lex to Rex! Outstanding story-rich game. Go!

notes.title: Steam Awards Nominations - Outstanding Story-Rich Game
notes.notes:
Hi lovely Majesties,

I´m proud of the story and plot I achieved in From Lex to Rex, and it seems many of you liked it too!

While the game has been an intense grinding for me, full of ups and downs, I can say that, as a writer myself, I´ve discovered a new and exciting way to tell stories. My main focus was giving you, not only the best story, but the best old school point and click game possible, and I´m still commited to it.

During this hard task it's always great to see the support I get from you and how much you have enjoyed the idea and story of the game, that´s why I would be humbled if you would [b]nominate From Lex to Rex on the category Outstanding Story-Rich Game.
[/b]

I can´t wait to hear from you and share with you exciting news!

As always, thank you.

notes.title: Minor update - Two announcements
notes.notes:
Greetins Your Majesties,

[list]
[*]Willing to make From Lex to Rex a more complete and better game, I´m adding better sounds and music in order to improve it. It´s a slow revision process, so expect continuous minor patches.

[*][b]I would like to make a call for reviews. [/b]. Developing a solo indie game it´s an ardous task full of learning. Support means everything, that´s why if you consider the game gave you a moment of joy and fun or even helped you forget about daily problems, please consider leaving a simple review.

[*]As you may know, From Lex to Rex is about food. Like the protagonist here many people can´t access basic food, that´s why, as gratitude, next week I´ll make a donation to the charital food gathering held in my hometown.
[/list]

Thank you so much, keep playing!

notes.title: Live-streaming Press Lex to Metaverx and Discord server.

As you all know, the Steam Next Fest October editions begins tomorrow and many demos will be streamed, including mine! I hope to see you there to play and talk about game related things.

Live-streamings times:
- Tuesday 10/4/2022 - 20:30 (UTC/GMT +2 )
- Sunday 10/9/2022 - 20:00 (UTC/GMT +2 )

One more thing. I´ve opened a Discord server so I can be in touch with all of you gamers who are interested. Just look for LEXCord in Discord.

See you!

notes.title: Press Lex to Next Fest.
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,

It is with great pleasure that I announce my next game, Press Lex to Metaverx, will be part of the Steam Next Festm, which takes place from the 3rd of October till the 10th. During the week I will publish the live-streaming dates, where you will be able to see the demo, enjoy it and even ask me whatever you please (hopefully game related).

See you inside the Metaverx!

notes.title: Press Lex to Metaverx
notes.notes:
Greetings, Your Majesties.

After From Lex to Rex, our dear Lex is in the mood for more adventures and he is willing to write a new chapter of his hungry life in the sequel b]Press Lex to Metaverx[/b].

[b]Press Lex to Metaverx[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2091740/Press_Lex_to_Metaverx/

What can we expect?
A polished game, squared, with more gastronomy and stories inside other stories. [i]A dish stuffed with another one [/i]. Crazy puzzles, old characters, new ones, decision making and an elaborated plot with character development.

[b]Cotton candy as cloth [/b]
For starters you all are welcome to savir the presequel in the form of a demo, [b]The Truffle Shuffle[/b], a chapter that will be included for free with the game. The demo will be temporary available, so try it a soon as possible!

One more thing...

[b]Press Lex to Metaverx[/b] will apper in the Steam Next Fest (October edition). See you there and in the updates!

notes.title: Polished update
notes.notes:
Today´s update has:
[olist]
[*] Fixed inventory issues.
[*] Changed some sounds for clearer ones.
[*] Fixed two minor issues with two animations.
[*] Added some suggested translation changes.
[*] The pause menu buttons have more space and now fit better.
[/olist]

[b]Is that a bird? A plane? No, it´s looks like am imminent annoucenment... [/b]

notes.title: Updates and Easter
notes.notes:
Your majesties,

Happy Easter! Do you know what´s very common during this time (besides processions here in Spain). Easter eggs! Turns out From Lex to Rex is stuffed with them, in particular as references to pop culture (from movies, paintings, other videogames, to sentences from books or lyrics). How´s the hunting going? You might get an achievement if you look closely...

As I said the last time, I´ve been polishing the game to solve translation stuff and that annoying thing with the cursor during the second stage. Looks like some reviews are on the way too. 
Play the game, enjoy the story and then go for those achievements!

notes.title: Lanzamiento From Lex to Rex
notes.notes:
Starving ends this friday! ¡Laughs, a feast and surprises!

Hail to the Lex!
